summary: The source is an SRS for “Project Aegis — Web-Based Credit Card Management System” describing a browser portal and REST API that support user authentication, a 3-step credit application flow, transaction initiation and history retrieval, account summary and card controls (freeze/unfreeze, lost/stolen, virtual PIN), billing statements and payment submission, plus notification webhooks. It also defines key BFSI security/compliance and non-functional requirements including PCI-DSS constraints, CSRF, session timeout behavior, latency/scalability targets, audit logging for credit_limit changes, PAN masking, and a right-to-rescind endpoint.

workflows.name: Platform entrypoints & API surface (Base URLs, TLS minimum)
workflows.description: Validate the published base API URL, portal URL, JSON format, and TLS 1.3 minimum expectations for connectivity and baseline contract.
workflows.rationale: Multiple externally referenced entrypoints and protocol requirements: Base API URL, portal URL, JSON, OAuth2+JWT, and “TLS 1.3 minimum”.

workflows.name: Web Application Architecture integrations (API gateway, microservices)
workflows.description: Validate key architectural integration expectations such as rate-limited/WAF-protected gateway behaviors and service decomposition assumptions that impact error handling/availability.
workflows.rationale: Architecture explicitly calls out “Rate-limited, WAF-protected” gateway and multiple microservices; warrants targeted integration/availability checks without inventing internal service APIs.

workflows.name: WebSocket live transaction feed endpoint
workflows.description: Validate the availability and secure connection behavior for the live transaction feed WebSocket endpoint used for real-time alerts/transactions.
workflows.rationale: A distinct access surface is specified (“wss://realtime.aegiscard.com/v2/stream”) and should be covered for connection and basic functional expectations.

workflows.name: User Registration (POST /v2/auth/register)
workflows.description: Create a portal user account and verify required fields, validation rules, and documented error conditions including duplicate email and weak password.
workflows.rationale: Many explicit field validations (name length/alpha, RFC 5322 email + uniqueness, password complexity, DOB age>=18, E.164 phone, ssn_last4 exactly 4 digits, agree_terms true) plus 201/400/409/422 outcomes.

workflows.name: Login & Token Issuance (POST /v2/auth/login)
workflows.description: Authenticate user credentials and validate token issuance, MFA optionality, trusted device/remember_me handling, and abuse controls (lockout, rate limiting).
workflows.rationale: Multiple branches and security controls: optional MFA code, device_id, remember_me; plus 200/401/403(lockout after 5)/429(10 req/min/IP) outcomes and response keys.

workflows.name: Token storage constraints (cookies not localStorage)
workflows.description: Verify the portal stores tokens in HttpOnly, Secure cookies and never in localStorage, including regression checks around SPA storage behavior.
workflows.rationale: Explicit storage prohibition is a high-risk security requirement for a browser-based BFSI app and must be validated in the UI runtime.

workflows.name: Token Refresh (POST /v2/auth/token/refresh) with rotation
workflows.description: Refresh access tokens using single-use refresh tokens and validate rotation/invalidation behavior and TOKEN_INVALID errors.
workflows.rationale: Security-critical rotation rules (single-use refresh token; old refresh invalidated) with explicit 200 and 401 outcomes and response keys.

workflows.name: Portal session timeout UX (15 min inactivity + warning modal)
workflows.description: Validate browser portal inactivity session expiration, including the 2-minute warning modal before auto-logout.
workflows.rationale: Explicit user-visible session behavior and timings are defined as NFR-06; requires UI + auth lifecycle coverage.

workflows.name: Credit Application Web Flow orchestration (3-step sequential + autosave)
workflows.description: Validate the multi-step application gating, ordering constraints, session_token issuance/usage, and autosave draft behavior in localStorage every 60 seconds.
workflows.rationale: Multi-step process with cross-step dependency (session_token from Step 1 required for Steps 2 & 3) plus explicit autosave cadence to localStorage.

workflows.name: Application Step 1 — Personal Information (POST /v2/applications/start)
workflows.description: Initiate a new credit card application and validate required fields, address rules, ID enums, and duplicate active application constraint.
workflows.rationale: Multiple field validations (name length, email match, E.164 phone, address subfields including province code and Canadian postal code format, id_type enum, id_number max) plus 201/400/409 outcomes and session_token issuance.

workflows.name: Application Step 2 — Financial Information (POST /v2/applications/{application_id}/financials)
workflows.description: Submit income/employment data, enforce X-App-Session header and 30-minute expiry, and validate conditional/required rules and error responses.
workflows.rationale: Many validations including enums, conditional employer_name required, numeric bounds (gross_annual_income max 9,999,999.99), defaults (other_income), and explicit SESSION_EXPIRED behavior; includes credit pull queued outcome keys.

workflows.name: Application Step 3 — Decision & Card Selection (POST /v2/applications/{application_id}/submit)
workflows.description: Finalize application with card_product_id dependency and e_signature, and validate all decision outcomes mapped to FICO thresholds.
workflows.rationale: Outcome matrix: APPROVED (FICO>680), PENDING (600-680), DECLINED (<600) all with distinct response keys, plus 400 SIGNATURE_REQUIRED; includes dependency on GET /v2/products for card_product_id source.

workflows.name: Initiate transaction (POST /v2/accounts/{account_id}/transactions)
workflows.description: Authorize and post web-initiated transactions with validation, ownership enforcement, card status gating, over-limit buffer behavior, and frequency/MFA trigger response.
workflows.rationale: High-risk money movement with many constraints: amount >0, currency/exchange_rate dependency, transaction_type enum, ownership rule, card state gating, over-limit buffer outcome, insufficient funds, invalid amount, and freq exceeded with mfa_required flag.

workflows.name: List transactions (GET /v2/accounts/{account_id}/transactions)
workflows.description: Retrieve paginated transaction history and validate filters, pagination bounds, date range validation, and forbidden access behavior.
workflows.rationale: Explicit query constraints (to_date >= from_date, page min 1, per_page max 100) and category enum; outcomes 200/400 INVALID_DATE_RANGE/403 FORBIDDEN with specific response keys.

workflows.name: Foreign transaction fee calculation (REQ-006)
workflows.description: Validate the foreign transaction CAD conversion formula and that the 3% fee is itemized separately as foreign_fee_amount.
workflows.rationale: Explicit numeric formula and itemization requirement; warrants golden-value and precision/edge validation where exchange_rate has Decimal(8,6).

workflows.name: Account summary (GET /v2/accounts/{account_id}/summary)
workflows.description: Retrieve account dashboard summary including balances, limits, status, billing cycle end, and optional rewards inclusion with owner-only access control.
workflows.rationale: Owner-only authorization plus include_rewards default false; validates presence of response keys and 403 FORBIDDEN behavior.

workflows.name: Freeze/Unfreeze card (PATCH /v2/cards/{card_id}/status)
workflows.description: Change card status between Active and Frozen with OTP confirmation, validate invalid transitions, and ensure reason is logged to audit trail.
workflows.rationale: State transition rules (only {Active,Frozen}), OTP requirement with attempts_remaining, INVALID_TRANSITION with allowed_transitions, and audit logging of reason.

workflows.name: Report lost/stolen (POST /v2/cards/{card_id}/report-lost)
workflows.description: Irreversibly block card and trigger re-issue workflow, validating loss_type enum and conflict behavior when already blocked/closed.
workflows.rationale: Irreversible action with explicit 200 and 409 ALREADY_BLOCKED outcomes and specified response keys; includes optional last_known_use and delivery_address.

workflows.name: Set/reset Virtual PIN (PUT /v2/cards/{card_id}/pin)
workflows.description: Set or reset PIN enforcing 4-digit format, confirmation match, OTP prerequisite, and blocked-card restriction.
workflows.rationale: Security-sensitive control with explicit input rules (exactly 4 digits; confirm match), OTP required, and 200/400/403 outcomes with distinct error codes.

workflows.name: Retrieve statement (GET /v2/accounts/{account_id}/statements/{statement_id})
workflows.description: Retrieve billing statement in JSON or PDF format and validate not-found behavior and required response keys.
workflows.rationale: Supports format enum {JSON,PDF} default JSON and 404 NOT_FOUND; includes multiple financial fields that must be present in response keys.

workflows.name: Billing calculations: Interest (ADB), grace period, late fee, rewards accrual/rounding, statement accuracy tolerance
workflows.description: Validate the documented financial rules applied to billing cycles including formulas, thresholds/conditions, rounding policy, and accuracy tolerance.
workflows.rationale: Multiple independent numeric/decision rules: ADB interest formula, grace period predicate, late fee trigger with +2 days tolerance, rewards accrual rates by MCC and floor-only rounding, and ±$0.01 statement accuracy tolerance.

workflows.name: Make a payment (POST /v2/accounts/{account_id}/payments)
workflows.description: Submit payments from linked bank accounts validating min/max constraints, payment_type enum, scheduled vs immediate behavior, and invalid bank account handling.
workflows.rationale: Money movement constraints: payment_amount min $1.00 and max=total_balance, scheduled_date future/omit for immediate, plus BELOW_MINIMUM and INVALID_BANK_ACCOUNT outcomes with keys.

workflows.name: PAN masking & frontend PAN non-exposure
workflows.description: Verify PAN is masked in browser display and that full PAN is never transmitted to the frontend.
workflows.rationale: Explicit REQ-014 with high PCI risk; requires UI/API payload inspection for masked output only.

workflows.name: Right to rescind (DELETE /v2/accounts/{{id}}) window enforcement
workflows.description: Validate account rescission is allowed within 14 days post-issuance with no membership fee and rejected after day 14.
workflows.rationale: Regulatory time-window rule with explicit endpoint and rejection condition; warrants boundary tests around Day 14 cutoff.

workflows.name: PCI-DSS L1 web form tokenization & no raw PAN in DOM
workflows.description: Validate card fields are iframe tokenized and that raw PAN never appears in the DOM, under TLS 1.3 transport constraints.
workflows.rationale: Explicit NFR-01 requirements around tokenization and DOM exposure; critical compliance verification in a browser context.

workflows.name: CSRF protection for state-changing endpoints
workflows.description: Verify that state-changing endpoints require X-CSRF-Token and that SameSite=Strict cookie policy is enforced.
workflows.rationale: Explicit NFR-05 requirement impacting multiple write endpoints; needs positive and missing/invalid header verification plus cookie policy check.

workflows.name: Audit trail for credit_limit changes (immutable log fields)
workflows.description: Verify that any credit_limit changes produce an immutable audit log entry with required fields user_id, session_id, ip_address, timestamp_utc.
workflows.rationale: A distinct compliance/observability requirement with specific mandatory fields; requires dedicated audit verification even if the change trigger is external to this SRS.

workflows.name: API latency p95 threshold
workflows.description: Measure and enforce API p95 latency ≤ 1,500 ms under defined load for key endpoints.
workflows.rationale: Explicit performance SLO for API p95 latency; should be validated with at least baseline and stressed profiles.

workflows.name: Portal Time-to-Interactive (TTI) threshold on 4G
workflows.description: Validate portal Time-to-Interactive ≤ 3s on a 4G network profile for SPA entry and authenticated dashboard.
workflows.rationale: Explicit UI performance threshold; requires at least entry page and a representative authenticated route validation.

workflows.name: Scalability throughput requirement (5,000 concurrent req/sec)
workflows.description: Validate API gateway sustains 5,000 concurrent requests per second without violating correctness and key error budgets.
workflows.rationale: Explicit scalability target for gateway; requires dedicated load test points separate from latency tests.

workflows.name: Auto-scaling trigger at 70% CPU utilization
workflows.description: Validate that auto-scaling triggers when CPU utilization reaches 70% under controlled load and that the system remains available.
workflows.rationale: Explicit autoscaling trigger threshold; should be validated as an operational performance workflow with measurable criteria.

workflows.name: Notification & alert webhook delivery (POST /v2/notifications/webhook)
workflows.description: Validate notification webhook contract including enums, message constraints, successful delivery response keys, and error handling.
workflows.rationale: Multiple required fields and enums (alert_type, channel, severity) with response outcomes 200/400 INVALID_ALERT_TYPE; also ties to real-time alerts to portal/email.

workflows.name: Notification webhook idempotency / deduplication
workflows.description: Validate that duplicate idempotency_key requests are rejected with 409 DUPLICATE_NOTIFICATION.
workflows.rationale: Explicit idempotency_key “prevents duplicate alert delivery” and 409 duplicate behavior; requires concurrency/duplicate-suppression coverage.
